process_observations.label: encoding-process-snapshot-1
argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; [Console]::OutputEncoding=New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false); $root=$env:MCPHUB_ENCODING_CLEANUP_SOURCE; $all=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Property ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine,ExecutablePath); $matches=@($all | Where-Object { ($_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine.IndexOf($root,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) -or ($_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath.StartsWith($root+'\',[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CommandLine,ExecutablePath); [pscustomobject]@{observed_utc=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); process_rows=$all.Count; missing_commandline=@($all | Where-Object {-not $_.CommandLine}).Count; missing_executable=@($all | Where-Object {-not $_.ExecutablePath}).Count; matches=$matches} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5
